# c4-skills-projects: skills and projects

Target: a new user's skills and projects, wherever the app offers them (settings, the chat home, the composer, the
sidebar).
Risks: changes lost or altered after a reload, forms that accept bad input or break on it, chats that end up in the
wrong project or disappear with it.
Start state: fresh user, desktop viewport, fake AI (select "Opus 5").
Out of bounds: account deletion, sign out, settings unrelated to skills and projects. How project instructions change
a real reply belongs to c5.
